answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake a bond and earn voting weight through useful work verified by unrelated peers. A new account may enter at a low-trust vertex, but influence grows only after its record survives several epochs. Coordinated attestations trigger a group audit and burn the colluders' bonds. This makes a relic-like reputation costly to copy, keeps a jetty of honest evidence open, and prevents disposable identities from capturing governance.
